novelty.justification: The claim's novelty route is a new mechanistic localization—"the subliminal trait is encoded primarily in the fine structure of the teacher's output distribution over low-probability tokens"—augmented by the prediction that the trait perturbation is "approximately low-rank and aligned with a trait direction." Searches for "subliminal learning logit tails," "behavioral trait soft-logit distillation," "low-probability token covert signal," and "top-k truncation subliminal learning" identify Cloud et al. (2025) as the closest phenomenon-level work, while Hinton et al. (2015), Don't Ignore the Tail (2026), and PILS (2025) separately establish informative soft-label tails and low-dimensional next-token distributions, but not tail-localized transmission of subliminal behavioral traits. The step is therefore a substantive natural extension and multi-part integration of known subliminal transmission, dark knowledge, and low-dimensional logit geometry—not merely a renamed method, but also not a wholly new core measurement paradigm—supporting standard rather than high novelty.
